manifest.name: space-permission-override
manifest.description: One flipped AI switch of one space: which of the five permissions this space set explicitly, who flipped it and when. A space with no rows runs on the package defaults. Keyed by opaque control-plane space id; no spaces table exists in this package.

migrations.name: create_space_permission_overrides
migrations.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS space_permission_overrides (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  space_id TEXT,
  scope_key TEXT UNIQUE,
  permission TEXT,
  enabled INTEGER CHECK(enabled IN (0, 1)),
  updated_by TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;

bootstrap.name: pg_bootstrap_space_permission_overrides
bootstrap.sql:
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "accordo";

CREATE TABLE "accordo"."space_permission_overrides" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  "space_id" TEXT,
  "scope_key" TEXT UNIQUE,
  "permission" TEXT,
  "enabled" BOOLEAN,
  "updated_by" TEXT,
  "created_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
